description: This file implements mutation tracking and dynamic module detection for PyTorch's Dynamo system, including classes for tracking mutations and module generation, and patching mechanisms for torch.nn.Module to detect dynamic creation and mutations.

classes.name: MutationTracker
classes.description: Tracks mutations to objects and invalidates associated cached code.

classes.name: GenerationTracker
classes.description: Tracks module creation timing to identify dynamic instances and manages generation state.

methods.name: track
methods.description: Adds a guarded code to be invalidated upon mutation.

methods.name: watch
methods.description: Sets up mutation tracking for an object and its guarded code.

methods.name: ensure_patched
methods.description: Patches a class's __setattr__ to track mutations.

methods.name: tag
methods.description: Tags an object with the current generation.

methods.name: mark_class_dynamic
methods.description: Marks a class as dynamically created.

methods.name: get_generation_value
methods.description: Retrieves the generation value for an object.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks if an object is from the current generation.

methods.name: is_dynamic_nn_module
methods.description: Determines if an object is a dynamically created or mutated nn.Module.

methods.name: install_generation_tagging_init
methods.description: Monkey patches torch.nn.Module's __init__ and __setstate__ to detect dynamic creation.
